title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @framework/presentation/core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary: Root-caused 'everything flying around / reintroduced every slide' via live CDP probing of every auto-animate target + its FLIP from-transform on the running projektetage deck. Finding: reveal.js's DEFAULT autoAnimateMatcher runs a text-content pass (h1..li by nodeName:::textContent) in addition to the data-id pass. For embodiments rendered as a [data-id] container with multiple inner lines (e.g. div[data-id=subtitle] with three <h2> lines), the inner lines have no data-id and were matched INDEPENDENTLY by text across slides (targets 5/6/7) while their parent div[data-id] was also matched (target 4). reveal then transformed both parent and children, compounding transforms and flinging the inner lines sideways (from-transforms translate(-423px..)/translate(-698px..)) — i.e. every embodiment animated as if reintroduced. Fix: replaced reveal's default matcher with a focused morphMatcher (renderer/react) that does a SINGLE findAutoAnimateMatches pass over '[data-id]' keyed by nodeName+data-id, and nothing else. Now only participant data-id anchors morph; embodiment-internal lines ride inside their matched container; shape changes (div[title]->h2[title]) fade like eg-ice-25. Verified live across all intro transitions: brand->title morphs name only; subtitle->authors and authors->institutions match exactly name/title/subtitle(/authors) with a uniform X=-168 + stepped vertical recenter and the new block fades in — no inner element flies. Added inline vitest asserting morphMatcher makes one '[data-id]' pass with nodeName+data-id serialization and never serializes inner lines. Tests green: renderer 4, core 6, @ui/react 81.
